description: The only Salesforce MCP with Agentforce, OmniStudio & DevOps Center tools — 228 total.
name: io.github.semwalajay83-sem/salesforce-metadata-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Salesforce access token (or use SF_ALIAS / JWT variables instead)
environmentVariables.name: SF_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Salesforce CLI org alias (alternative to SF_ACCESS_TOKEN)
environmentVariables.name: SF_ALIAS

environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to load at startup: 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated list. Default: core,metadata. All 228 tools stay available via sf_find_tool / sf_load_toolset.
environmentVariables.name: SF_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.description: Refuse destructive tools on production orgs: 'destructive' (default), 'strict', or 'off'. Metadata creation is never affected.
environmentVariables.name: SF_PRODUCTION_GUARD
